essence: Śiva possesses a nature that encompasses all modes and enables autonomous action
Śiva creates the diverse universe for the enjoyment of experiencing beings
The world’s origin is Śaṅkara, not a material seed like that of a picture
Observed material causes, like thread, are unconscious
The knowledge and action of the great lord cannot be excluded as the cause
